messages:
Marie: starting handoff for sa-east-1 (Sao Paulo) GA prep. quick status + open questions.
Raj: infra side: VPCs, subnet design, terraform modules all pushed. need confirmation on kms key ARN and whether routing tenancy should be shared or dedicated. @Anya can you confirm kms timeline?
Anya: security: kms request filed (ticket #SEC-874). expected by EOD tomorrow but might slip if compliance asks for extra info. any residency specifics beyond 'keep data in BR'?
Luis: product: current beta customers require BR-only residency + 7d audit logs. also need a console toggle for residency enforcement. will customers need cross-region replication for backups?
Nico: sre: we need an emergency fallback plan to us-east-1 for capacity/failover. propose routing policy that prefers sa-east-1 then falls back to us-east-1 with rate-limited spill. sample policy: 
```
route_preference: [sa-east-1, us-east-1]
spill_threshold_rps: 1200
spill_rate_limit: 300rps
```
Tom: runtime: model binaries and quant profiles uploaded. canary shows slightly higher p95 on longer sequences when quantized — will run extended test with 40k seqs today and post results. no blocker for GA if within 10% p95 delta.
Clara: PM: can we freeze any API/config schema changes after TOMORROW noon? also who formally owns the DR runbook for this region? @Marie @Nico
Deploy Bot: Canary deploy started for sa-east-1 at 2026-03-16T18:22:10Z (canary-id: c-20260316-sa).
Marie: quick owner map i propose — KMS/keys: @Anya; routing policy & infra tags: @Raj; DR/runbook + failover: @Nico; runtime/canary: @Tom; product toggles + customer comms: @Luis. please confirm or reassign.
Raj: confirm for routing & infra. one note: cloud provider tag limit may block the extra residency tag for some infra resources, we need a tag minimization PR.
Anya: heads up - compliance requested a data flow diagram, so kms ETA bumped +48h. i've added details to #security-requests and linked the ticket.
Luis: ok i'll pause customer GA invites until residency and toggle are ready. i'll prepare comms and update beta customers. need console toggle from @Tom's team.
Nico: i'll own the DR runbook. i'll draft a lightweight checklist and post for review by EOD today. agree with fallback to us-east-1 as a short-term option.
Tom: console toggle is doable; i'll open a small PR and ping @Raj for infra changes (tags). aiming to ship toggle + tests by tomorrow morning.
Marie: great. next async sync tomorrow 09:30 BRT. if blockers surface, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
